Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 6. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): Applicable at firms premises by CGM, OFCH and PD, MSQAA Hyderabad or their authorized representative Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Applicable at OFCH premises by CGM, OFCH and PD, MSQAA Hyderabad or their authorized representative 7. HEM RL / PYRO / PS / 207(C) Material No. 12003255 / 6454000053 B] ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR T.E. (Custom Two BID) : (1) Only established with registered vendors / supplier of the tender item at OFCH or at any of th e Ordnance Factories of erstwhile OFB are eligible to participate in this T.E. (2) For any established but not registered vendor for the tender item, it will be essential to get re gistration for tendered item before tender opening date at OFCH for which such vendors shall a pply before tender opening date & time by applying & submitting online VRRF (Vendor Registra tion Request Form) & Fees (including 18% GST) through the website with web address http://v endor.munitionsindia.in along with relevant documents for processing of registration. The re gistration application of such bidders shall be processed as per MIL SOP for Vendor Registration and the bidder whose Vendor Registration application shall be rejected shall not be eligible for price bid opening. Unregistered bidders after applying & submitting through the above website should immediate intimate about VRFF & Fees submission on to O.F.CHANDA/P.V. Section e-mai l on provofch@ord.gov.in and on O.F.CHANDA/QAP Section on e-mail ofchstdcell@ord.gov. in or stdcell.ofch@munitionsindia.in to process the registration. NOTE – As per MIL PM Provision : The status whether a firm is established or not shall be recko ned on the last day of previous month in which VSL TPC is held i.e. on 30/09/2026. (3) GeM GTC Clause No.29 “One Bid One Bidder” will be applicable and any bid not found in or der will not be considered and shall be liable for disqualification. (4) If, IP address of the bidder matched with IP address of other participated bidder in instant bid,

the offer of frim with common IP address may be rejected straightway in suspect of cartel form ation. C] INSPECTION : (1) Inspection of the store will be carried out as per “Quality Monitoring Instructions (Revisi on 1) for Inspection Procedure Documents No.7201/QMI/QC (Mat)/002, Dtd.09/10/2024” – As pr ovided along with T.E. The submission / communication in this regard may be done on OFCH Q C (Mat) email ID i.e., qcmat.ofch@munitionsindia.in. (2) In case testing of RM’s is done at OFCH Lab as mentioned in para 5.2 & 5.3 of QMI, the c ost of testing will be borne by the firm. (3) In the event, where retesting / resampling at firm’s premises is warranted on account of failure in the first time inspection, the cost of subsequent inspection for said consignment will b e borne by the firm. (4) Inspection Type / Place : Pre-dispatch inspection at Firms Premises. (5) Inspection Officer : Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Chanda and Principal Dire ctor, Missile System Quality Assurance Agency, Hyderabad (MSQAA) or their authorized represe ntative. D] GUARANTEE / WARRANTEE CLAUSE : 18 months from the date of dispatch or 12 months fro m the date of acceptance whichever is earlier. E] OTHER DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED BY VENDORS: (1) Bidder must upload dully filled, signed & stamped of “COMPLIANCE STATEMENT (LT E CASE)” for tender item. (2) Bidder must upload dully filled, signed & stamped of “TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION C OMPLIANCE SHEET OF TENDERED ITEM”. (3) Bidder must submit declaration w.r.t. Make In India (MII) Clause along with offer, speci ally mentioning percent of Local Content & Place of Local Value addition. (4) Bidder must select MSEs firm option on GeM-Portal & upload / submit Udyam Registrati on Certificate to gain MSEs advantage. (5) Bidder must submit complete set of GST registration Certificate along with Bid documen ts giving details of Managing / Whole-time Directors & Key Managerial persons. (6) Bidder will raise all its invoices against Ordnance Factory Chanda GST No. 27AAOCM87 81H6ZL for delivery of tendered item to O.F. Chanda. (7) Firm will submit proof of GSTR-1 (B2B Form) along with contractor bills & Cancelled Che que for release of payment. NOTE : (1) Bidders must offer / upload of specification against their offered specification same as buyer s uploaded specification (dully signed & stamped copy) only. And also offered item nomenclatur e / Model name as per buyers tendered item nomenclature. (2) All other standard clauses within overall ambit of provisions of MILPM 2023 are to be applicable. .
